What it solves: ## What is wrong
Approval context: A new feature file is authored here, so it needs a tap. No choice is posed and there are no ruling_options. FIRM: extension/src is not edited - buildTurnProfileWindowRecord and the transcript walker are BL-1364's landed contract and the property agrees with them on every draw; the fix is in the tes…
